local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("SpideyWebVisuals")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local fighters = {}
local touching = false
local clock = 0
local function attr(f, key, fallback)
	local v = f.model:GetAttribute(key)
	return type(v) == "number" and v == v and math.abs(v) < math.huge and v or fallback
end
local function isSpider(f) return f.model:GetAttribute("AbilityId") == "SpideyWeb" end
local function speedOf(model)
	local s = model:GetAttribute("Speed")
	assert(type(s) == "number" and s > 0, "Speed invalide : " .. model.Name)
	return s
end
local function sound(head, name, id, volume)
	local oldSound = head:FindFirstChild(name); if oldSound then oldSound:Destroy() end
	local s = Instance.new("Sound"); s.Name = name; s.SoundId = id; s.Volume = volume
	s.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered; s.RollOffMinDistance = 60; s.RollOffMaxDistance = 180
	s.Parent = head; return s
end
local function anchor(name)
	local p = Instance.new("Part"); p.Name = name; p.Size = Vector3.one * 0.1; p.Transparency = 1
	p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanTouch = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.Parent = visuals
	local a = Instance.new("Attachment"); a.Parent = p; return p, a
end
for i, name in ipairs({ "Fighter1", "Fighter2" }) do
	local model = workspace:WaitForChild(name)
	local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head", true)
	if head and not head:IsA("BasePart") then head = head:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
	assert(head and head:IsA("BasePart"), "Head introuvable : " .. name)
	for _, p in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false end
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = head; head.PivotOffset = CFrame.identity
	local previous = model:FindFirstChild("ImpactFlash"); if previous then previous:Destroy() end
	local flash = Instance.new("Highlight"); flash.Name = "ImpactFlash"; flash.Adornee = model
	flash.FillTransparency = 1; flash.OutlineTransparency = 1; flash.Parent = model
	local p0, a0 = anchor(name .. "WebOrigin"); local p1, a1 = anchor(name .. "WebTip")
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam"); beam.Name = "SpideySilk"; beam.Attachment0 = a0; beam.Attachment1 = a1
	beam.Width0 = 0.075; beam.Width1 = 0.035; beam.FaceCamera = true; beam.LightEmission = 0.12
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 248)); beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.08)
	beam.Segments = 12; beam.Enabled = false; beam.Parent = visuals
	for _, key in ipairs({ "SpideyTrail", "SpideyTrailTop", "SpideyTrailBottom" }) do
		local obj = head:FindFirstChild(key); if obj then obj:Destroy() end
	end
	local top = Instance.new("Attachment"); top.Name = "SpideyTrailTop"; top.Position = Vector3.new(0, head.Size.Y * .35, 0); top.Parent = head
	local bottom = Instance.new("Attachment"); bottom.Name = "SpideyTrailBottom"; bottom.Position = Vector3.new(0, -head.Size.Y * .35, 0); bottom.Parent = head
	local second=beam:Clone();second.Name="SpideyVolleySilk";second.CurveSize0=.65;second.CurveSize1=.65;second.Parent=visuals
 local third=beam:Clone();third.Name="SpideyVolleySilk";third.CurveSize0=-.65;third.CurveSize1=-.65;third.Parent=visuals
 local trail = Instance.new("Trail"); trail.Name = "SpideyTrail"; trail.Attachment0 = top; trail.Attachment1 = bottom
	trail.Lifetime = .17; trail.MinLength = .2; trail.FaceCamera = true; trail.LightEmission = .5
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(230, 250, 255)); trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(.45, 1)
	trail.Enabled = false; trail.Parent = head
	local s = speedOf(model)
	fighters[i] = { model = model, head = head, start = Vector2.new(head.Position.X, head.Position.Y),
		position = Vector2.new(head.Position.X, head.Position.Y), depth = head.Position.Z, rotation = head.CFrame.Rotation,
		radius = math.max(head.Size.X, head.Size.Y) / 2, speed = s, velocity = Vector2.new(1, 0) * s,
		flash = flash, flashTime = 0, priority = 0, lastWallSound = -math.huge,
		wallSound = sound(head, "WallBounceSound", "rbxassetid://1885641628", .28),
		hitSound = sound(head, "CollisionHitSound", "rbxassetid://110024396934410", .45),
		originPart = p0, tipPart = p1, beam = beam, extraBeams={second,third}, trail = trail,
		nextWeb = 2.5, strike = false, coastUntil = 0,
	}
end
local function world(f, p) return Vector3.new(p.X, p.Y, f.depth - f.head.Size.Z * .5 - .1) end
local function flash(f, enemy)
	local priority = enemy and 2 or 1
	if f.flashTime <= 0 or priority >= f.priority then
		local c = enemy and Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 55) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		f.flash.FillColor = c; f.flash.OutlineColor = c; f.priority = priority
	end
	f.flashTime = .18
end
local function cancelCharge(f)
	local sting=f.sting
 if sting then
  local target=sting.target
  AbilityGate.Resume(target.model,"SpideyInjection")
  if target.capturedBy==f then target.capturedBy=nil;target.velocity=sting.savedVelocity;target.model:SetAttribute("WebImmobilized",false)end
  f.velocity=sting.ownVelocity;f.sting=nil;f.model:SetAttribute("SpideyStingingUntil",nil)
 end
 local charge = f.charge
	if charge and charge.target and charge.target.capturedBy == f then
		local target = charge.target
		target.capturedBy = nil
		target.velocity = charge.savedVelocity
		target.model:SetAttribute("WebImmobilized", false)
	end
	f.charge = nil; f.shot = nil; f.volley=nil; f.beam.Enabled = false
 for _,beam in ipairs(f.extraBeams)do beam.Enabled=false end
end
local pushEvent=SSS:WaitForChild("CraxTonguePush")
local function acceptTonguePush(attacker,target)
 if AbilityGate.Paused(attacker)then return end
 if state:GetAttribute("Phase")~="Fighting"or state:GetAttribute("GhostNightActive")
  or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<(state:GetAttribute("GhostFreezeUntil")or 0)then return end
 local a,b
 for _,f in ipairs(fighters)do if f.model==attacker then a=f elseif f.model==target then b=f end end
 if not a or not b or (b.model:GetAttribute("Health")or 0)<=0
  or b.model:GetAttribute("GhostInvulnerable")then return end
 if b.capturedBy then cancelCharge(b.capturedBy)end
 cancelCharge(b);b.strike=false;b.model:SetAttribute("WebCharging",false)
 local delta=b.position-a.position
 local direction=delta.Magnitude>.001 and delta.Unit or Vector2.new(1,0)
 b.knockback={velocity=direction*72,remaining=.24}
end
pushEvent.Event:Connect(acceptTonguePush)
local function pushStep(f,dt)
 local push=f.knockback
 if not push then return Vector2.zero end
 if state:GetAttribute("GhostNightActive")or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<(state:GetAttribute("GhostFreezeUntil")or 0)then
  f.knockback=nil;return Vector2.zero
 end
 local time=math.min(dt,push.remaining)
 local offset=push.velocity*((1-math.exp(-8*time))/8)
 push.velocity=push.velocity*math.exp(-8*time);push.remaining=push.remaining-time
 if push.remaining<=.00001 then f.knockback=nil end
 return offset
end
local function clearWebs()
 Skills.Clear()
	for _, f in ipairs(fighters) do cancelCharge(f);AbilityGate.Reset(f.model) end
	for _, f in ipairs(fighters) do
		f.attackRed=false;f.pendingSting=nil;f.followupEligible=false;f.capturedBy = nil; f.strike = false; f.coastUntil = 0; f.knockback=nil
		f.model:SetAttribute("WebImmobilized", false); f.model:SetAttribute("WebCharging", false)
		f.trail.Enabled = false; f.trail:Clear()
	end
end
local function wallEndpoint(position, direction)
	local distance = math.huge
	if direction.X > .00001 then distance = math.min(distance, (24 - position.X) / direction.X)
	elseif direction.X < -.00001 then distance = math.min(distance, (-24 - position.X) / direction.X) end
	if direction.Y > .00001 then distance = math.min(distance, (45 - position.Y) / direction.Y)
	elseif direction.Y < -.00001 then distance = math.min(distance, (5 - position.Y) / direction.Y) end
	return position + direction * math.max(0, distance)
end
local function shoot(f, enemy,red)
 if not InvertedSilence.CanStart(f.model)then return end
 if f.sting or f.capturedBy or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()<(f.model:GetAttribute("SpideyStingingUntil")or 0)then return end
	local opposite = Vector2.new(-f.position.X, 50 - f.position.Y)
	local delta = opposite - f.position
	local direction = delta.Magnitude > .001 and delta.Unit or f.velocity.Unit
	if direction.Magnitude < .001 then direction = Vector2.new(1, 0) end
	if not f.sting then cancelCharge(f)end
	f.strike = false
 f.attackRed=red==true
 f.volley=red and 2 or 1
 f.followupEligible=false;f.followupWait=not red
 if f.volley==2 then
  local speed=math.max(f.speed,f.velocity.Magnitude)
  local direction=f.velocity.Magnitude>.001 and f.velocity.Unit or Vector2.new(1,0)
  f.volleyBoostSpeed=speed+math.max(12,f.speed*.65)
  f.velocity=direction*f.volleyBoostSpeed

local function ensureEvent(parent, name, className)
	local event = parent:FindFirstChild(name)

	if not event then
		event = Instance.new(className)
		event.Name = name
		event.Parent = parent
	end

	assert(event:IsA(className), name .. " doit être un " .. className)
	return event
end

ensureEvent(SSS, "BiteHit", "BindableEvent")

local selectionEvent = ensureEvent(
	RS,
	"CraxSelectionEvent",
	"RemoteEvent"
)

local catalog = require(RS:WaitForChild("CraxCatalog"))
local Selection = require(SSS:WaitForChild("CraxRoundSelection"))
local Direction = require(SSS:WaitForChild("CraxDirectionServer"))

local Skin = require(SSS:WaitForChild("CraxSkinServer"))
local fighters = {
	workspace:WaitForChild("Fighter1"),
	workspace:WaitForChild("Fighter2"),
}

local function configure(model, chosenId)
	local id = chosenId
		or model:GetAttribute("CraxId")
		or "Crax_Monster"

	local config = catalog[id]
	assert(config, "Crax absent du catalogue : " .. tostring(id))
	assert(type(config.Speed) == "number" and config.Speed > 0)
	assert(type(config.MaxHealth) == "number" and config.MaxHealth > 0)

	local ability = config.Ability or {}

	model:SetAttribute("CraxId", id)
	model:SetAttribute("DisplayName", config.DisplayName)
	model:SetAttribute("Rarity", config.Rarity)
	model:SetAttribute("MaxHealth", config.MaxHealth)
	model:SetAttribute("Speed", config.Speed)
	model:SetAttribute("CollisionDamage", config.CollisionDamage or 5)
	model:SetAttribute("AbilityId", ability.Id or "")
	model:SetAttribute("BiteDamage", ability.Damage or 20)
	model:SetAttribute("BiteCooldown", math.max(0.1, ability.Cooldown or 5))
	model:SetAttribute("BiteExtraRange", ability.ExtraRange or 3.25)
 local webKeys = {Cooldown="WebCooldown",WebSpeed="WebSpeed",Acceleration="WebAcceleration",
  MaxSpeed="WebMaxSpeed",CriticalDamage="WebCriticalDamage",MaxDamage="WebMaxDamage",
  MinDamage="WebMinDamage",DamageScale="WebDamageScale",MaxChargeTime="WebMaxChargeTime",CoastTime="WebCoastTime"}
 for key,attribute in pairs(webKeys) do
  model:SetAttribute(attribute,ability.Id=="SpideyWeb" and ability[key] or nil)
 end
 local nightKeys={Cooldown="NightCooldown",Duration="NightDuration",Damage="NightSlashDamage",BleedChance="NightBleedChance"}
 for key,attribute in pairs(nightKeys) do
  model:SetAttribute(attribute,ability.Id=="GhostNightSlash" and ability[key] or nil)
 end
 Skin.Apply(model,id,config)
end

configure(fighters[1])
configure(fighters[2])

local function prepareRoundVictory()
 if require(SSS:WaitForChild('CraxKillaVictoryV73')).Publish(state)then return end
 if state:GetAttribute("Phase")~="RoundOver"then return end
 local round=state:GetAttribute("RoundId")
 -- GoldenVictoryOrderFix_v2
 -- Le bridge vérifie lui-même si cette victoire Golden a déjà été publiée.
 if require(SSS:WaitForChild("FleauFinaleBridge")).Publish(state)then return end

 if state:GetAttribute("RoundVictoryRound")==round then return end
 local winner=state:GetAttribute("RoundWinner")
 local model=(winner=="Fighter1"or winner=="Fighter2")and workspace:FindFirstChild(winner)
 local spec=model and model:GetAttribute("CraxId")~="Crax_Golden" and model:GetAttribute("CraxId")~="Crax_Fleau" and victoryCatalog[model:GetAttribute("CraxId")]
 local enhanced=spec and(model:GetAttribute("CraxSkillLevel")or 0)>=spec.MinimumLevel
 local start=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 local duration=enhanced and((spec.IntroDuration or 0)+spec.Duration+spec.ZoomDuration+spec.HoldDuration)or 3
 if model and model:GetAttribute('CraxId')=='Crax_Super'then
  state:SetAttribute('SuperVictoryCrax','Crax_Super');state:SetAttribute('SuperVictoryLevel',model:GetAttribute('CraxSkillLevel')or 0)
  state:SetAttribute('SuperVictoryMatch',state:GetAttribute('CraxMatchToken'));state:SetAttribute('SuperVictoryOwner',model.Name)
 end

 end

 state:SetAttribute("RoundVictoryKind",enhanced and spec.Id or "")

 state:SetAttribute("RoundVictoryRound",round)
end

local function clearVictory()
	victoryGui.Enabled = false
	victoryLabel.Text = ""
end

local function playerAtSeat(seat)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player:GetAttribute("ArenaSeat") == seat then
			return player
		end
	end
end

local matchNames = {}

local function showVictory(seat)
	local player = playerAtSeat(seat)
	local name = player and player.Name or matchNames[seat]

	if name then
		victoryLabel.Text = "Victoire de " .. name
		victoryGui.Enabled = true
	else
		clearVictory()
	end
end

local function updateScores()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character

		if character then
			local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local seat = player:GetAttribute("ArenaSeat")
			local gui = character:FindFirstChild("ArenaScoreGui")

			local visible = state:GetAttribute("ScoresVisible")
				and head ~= nil
				and (seat == 1 or seat == 2)

			if not visible then
				if gui then
					gui.Enabled = false
				end
			else
				if not gui then
					gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
					gui.Name = "ArenaScoreGui"
					gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 110)
					gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
					gui.MaxDistance = 250
					gui.Parent = character

					local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
					text.Name = "Score"
					text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
					text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
					text.TextSize = 64
					text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					text.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 15, 10)
					text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.15
					text.Parent = gui
				end

				gui.Adornee = head

				-- Plus haut que dans l'ancienne version.
				gui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
				gui.Enabled = true
				gui.Score.Text = tostring(
					state:GetAttribute("Score" .. seat) or 0
				)
			end
		end
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while script.Parent do
		updateScores()
		task.wait(0.15)
	end
end)

local activeSelections = {}
local selectionDeadline = 0
local fastClosing = false

local function sendOpen(player, record)
 local pricing=Selection.Snapshot(player)
	selectionEvent:FireClient(player, "Open", {
		RoundId = record.roundId,
		Offers = record.offers,
		Deadline = selectionDeadline,
		FreeChoiceAvailable = record.freeAvailable,
		SelectedId = record.selectedId,
		Locked = record.locked,
		FastClosing = fastClosing,
        MatchToken=state:GetAttribute("CraxMatchToken"),MatchRoundIndex=state:GetAttribute("MatchRoundIndex"),
        InventoryCost=pricing.InventoryCost,Gems=pricing.Gems,
	})
end

local function isOffered(record, id)
	for _, offered in ipairs(record.offers) do
		if offered == id then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function feedback(player, record, success, message, requestId, charged)
 local pricing=Selection.Snapshot(player)
	selectionEvent:FireClient(player, "Feedback", {
		RoundId = record.roundId,
		Success = success,
		Message = message,
		SelectedId = record.selectedId,
		FreeChoiceAvailable = record.freeAvailable,
		Locked = record.locked,
        RequestId=requestId,Charged=charged or 0,InventoryCost=pricing.InventoryCost,Gems=pricing.Gems,
	})
end

	player,

	craxId,

			sendOpen(player, record)
		end

		return
	end

	if not record
		or roundId ~= record.roundId
		or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "Selecting"
		or player:GetAttribute("ArenaSeat") ~= record.seat
		or workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= selectionDeadline then
        if record and roundId==record.roundId then feedback(player,record,false,"Sélection terminée ou indisponible.",requestId)end
		return
	end

	if record.locked then
        feedback(player,record,false,"Choix déjà verrouillé.",requestId)
		return
	end

	if action == "Lock" then
		if not record.selectedId then
			feedback(player, record, false, "Choisis d'abord un Crax.",requestId)
			return
		end

		record.locked = true
        local levels=player:FindFirstChild("CraxSkillLevels")
        local value=levels and levels:FindFirstChild(record.selectedId)
        record.badgeLevel=value and value:IsA("IntValue")and math.clamp(value.Value,0,4)or 0
        if record.badgeLevel>0 then
         badgeEvent:FireClient(player,{Round=record.roundId,Seat=record.seat,Level=record.badgeLevel})
        end
		feedback(player, record, true, "Choix verrouillé. En attente de l'autre joueur.",requestId)

		local count = 0
		local allLocked = true

		for _, other in pairs(activeSelections) do
			count += 1

			if not other.locked then
				allLocked = false
			end
		end

		if count == 2 and allLocked and not fastClosing then
			fastClosing = true

			-- Ne rallonge pas le temps s'il reste déjà moins de 3 secondes.
			selectionDeadline = math.min(
				selectionDeadline,
				workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 3
			)

			for target, other in pairs(activeSelections) do
                Selection.SetDeadline(target,other.roundId,selectionDeadline)
				selectionEvent:FireClient(target, "Deadline", {
					RoundId = other.roundId,
					Deadline = selectionDeadline,
					FastClosing = true,
				})
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if action ~= "Choose"
		or type(craxId) ~= "string"
		or type(direct) ~= "boolean" then

		return
	end

	local success
	local message
    local charged=0

	if direct then
		success, message, charged = Selection.ChooseFromInventory(
			player, roundId, craxId, requestId
		)
	else
		success, message = Selection.Choose(
			player, roundId, craxId
		)
	end

	if success then
		record.selectedId = Selection.Selected(player, roundId)

		record.freeAvailable = Selection.Snapshot(player).FreeChoiceAvailable
	end

	feedback(player, record, success, message, requestId, charged)
end)

local function closeSelections()
	for player, record in pairs(activeSelections) do
		if player.Parent == Players then
			selectionEvent:FireClient(player, "Close", {
				RoundId = record.roundId,
			})
		end
	end

	activeSelections = {}
end

	activeSelections[player] = nil
	Selection.RemovePlayer(player)
end)

local required = {
	{ name = "ArenaMovement", ready = "MovementReady" },
	{ name = "CombatHealth", ready = "HealthReady" },
	{ name = "MonsterBiteAbilities", ready = "AbilitiesReady" },
}

local started = os.clock()
local previousWarning = ""

while true do
	local missing = {}

	for _, system in ipairs(required) do
		local combatScript = SSS:FindFirstChild(system.name)

		if not combatScript or not combatScript:IsA("Script") then
			table.insert(missing, system.name .. " : absent ou incorrect")
		elseif not combatScript.Enabled then
			table.insert(missing, system.name .. " : désactivé")
		elseif not state:GetAttribute(system.ready) then
			table.insert(missing, system.name .. " : initialisation bloquée")
		end
	end

	if #missing == 0 then
		break
	end

	if os.clock() - started >= 5 then
		local message = table.concat(missing, " | ")

		if message ~= previousWarning then
			previousWarning = message
			warn("RoundManager — " .. message)
		end
	end

	task.wait(0.2)
end

local function twoPlayersReady()
	return state:GetAttribute("PlayersReady") == 2
		and playerAtSeat(1) ~= nil
		and playerAtSeat(2) ~= nil
end

while true do
	closeSelections()
	clearVictory()

	state:SetAttribute("ScoresVisible", false)
	state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Waiting")
	state:SetAttribute("Score1", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("Score2", 0)
	state:SetAttribute("RoundWinner", "")
	state:SetAttribute("MatchWinner", 0)

	while not twoPlayersReady() do
		task.wait(0.2)
	end

	local participants = {
		playerAtSeat(1),
		playerAtSeat(2),
	}

	matchNames = {
		participants[1].Name,
		participants[2].Name,
	}

	state:SetAttribute("MatchEndReason", "")
	state:SetAttribute("CraxMatchToken", game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false))
	-- CraxAbandonRound_v2
	state:SetAttribute("MatchRoundIndex", 0)
	Selection.BeginMatch(participants)

	local function participantsReady()
		return twoPlayersReady()
			and playerAtSeat(1) == participants[1]
			and playerAtSeat(2) == participants[2]
	end

	local cancelled = false

	-- Recul de caméra terminé avant le premier chiffre du décompte.
	state:SetAttribute("CameraTransitionDuration", CAMERA_PULLBACK_TIME)
	state:SetAttribute("CameraTransitionEnd", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + CAMERA_PULLBACK_TIME)
	state:SetAttribute("Phase", "CameraTransition")

	while workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < state:GetAttribute("CameraTransitionEnd") do
		if not participantsReady()
			or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "CameraTransition" then
			cancelled = true
			break
		end
		task.wait(0.03)
	end

	if not participantsReady()
		or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "CameraTransition" then
		cancelled = true
	end

	-- Premier décompte : le menu et les scores restent cachés.
	if not cancelled then
		state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Preparing")
	end

	for number = 3, 1, -1 do
		if not participantsReady()
			or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "Preparing" then

			cancelled = true
			break
		end

		task.wait(1)
	end

	if not participantsReady()
		or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "Preparing" then

		cancelled = true
	end

	if not cancelled then
		state:SetAttribute("ScoresVisible", true)
	end

	while not cancelled
		and state:GetAttribute("Score1") < ROUNDS_TO_WIN
		and state:GetAttribute("Score2") < ROUNDS_TO_WIN do

		if not participantsReady() then
			cancelled = true
			break
		end

		clearVictory()

		local roundId = state:GetAttribute("RoundId") + 1
		state:SetAttribute("RoundWinner", "")
		for _,fighter in ipairs(fighters)do
         fighter:SetAttribute("CraxBadgeLocked",false)
         fighter:SetAttribute("CraxBadgeRound",nil)
         fighter:SetAttribute("CraxBadgeLevel",nil)
        end
        state:SetAttribute("MatchRoundIndex", (state:GetAttribute("MatchRoundIndex") or 0) + 1)
        state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Selecting")

		selectionDeadline = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + SELECTION_TIME
		fastClosing = false
		activeSelections = {}

		for seat, player in ipairs(participants) do
			local data = Selection.BeginRound(player, roundId, selectionDeadline, seat)

			if #data.Offers == 0 then
				warn("Aucun Crax possédé pour " .. player.Name)
				cancelled = true
				break
			end

			activeSelections[player] = {
				roundId = roundId,
				seat = seat,
				offers = data.Offers,
				freeAvailable = data.FreeChoiceAvailable,
				selectedId = nil,
				locked = false,
			}
		end

		if cancelled then
			break
		end

		for player, record in pairs(activeSelections) do
			sendOpen(player, record)
		end

		while workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < selectionDeadline do
			if not participantsReady()
				or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "Selecting" then

				cancelled = true
				break
			end

			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		if not participantsReady()
			or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "Selecting" then

			cancelled = true
		end

		if cancelled then
			break
		end

		local chosen = {}
        local lockedBadges={}
        for _,record in pairs(activeSelections)do
         if record.locked then lockedBadges[record.seat]=record.badgeLevel or 0 end
        end

		for seat, player in ipairs(participants) do
			chosen[seat] = Selection.FinishRound(player, roundId)

			if not chosen[seat] then
				cancelled = true
			end
		end

		closeSelections()

		if cancelled then
			break
		end

		-- Révélation : les choix sont appliqués simultanément.
		for seat, player in ipairs(participants) do
			configure(fighters[seat], chosen[seat])
            fighters[seat]:SetAttribute("CraxBadgeRound",roundId)
            fighters[seat]:SetAttribute("CraxBadgeLevel",lockedBadges[seat]or 0)
            fighters[seat]:SetAttribute("CraxBadgeLocked",(lockedBadges[seat]or 0)>0)
			player:SetAttribute("SelectedCrax", chosen[seat])
		end

		state:SetAttribute("RoundId", roundId)
		task.wait(0.15)

		if not participantsReady()
			or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "Selecting" then

			cancelled = true
			break
		end

		if not Direction.Run(participants, roundId) then
			cancelled = true
			break
		end

		state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Fighting")

		while state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "Fighting"
			and participantsReady() do

			task.wait(0.1)
		end

		if not participantsReady()
			or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "RoundOver" then

			cancelled = true
			break
		end

		local winner = state:GetAttribute("RoundWinner")

		if winner == "Fighter1" then
			state:SetAttribute("Score1", state:GetAttribute("Score1") + 1)
            require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService").CraxDailyQuests).Round(participants[1],tostring(state:GetAttribute("CraxMatchToken"))..":"..tostring(state:GetAttribute("RoundId")))
			showVictory(1)
		elseif winner == "Fighter2" then
			state:SetAttribute("Score2", state:GetAttribute("Score2") + 1)
            require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService").CraxDailyQuests).Round(participants[2],tostring(state:GetAttribute("CraxMatchToken"))..":"..tostring(state:GetAttribute("RoundId")))
			showVictory(2)
		else
			clearVictory()
		end

		prepareRoundVictory()
        local remaining=math.max(0,(state:GetAttribute("RoundVictoryEndsAt")or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+3)-workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
        -- GhostyRoundDuration_v3
local ghostState=workspace:FindFirstChild("CombatState")
local ghostWinner=ghostState and workspace:FindFirstChild(ghostState:GetAttribute("RoundWinner")or "")
local ghostMax=ghostWinner and (ghostWinner:GetAttribute("CraxId")=="Crax_Ghosty"or ghostWinner:GetAttribute("CraxId")=="Crax_Fantastic")and(ghostWinner:GetAttribute("CraxSkillLevel")or 0)>=4

local pauseEnd = os.clock() + (ghostMax and math.max(10, (remaining)) or (remaining))

		while os.clock() < pauseEnd do
			if not participantsReady()
				or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "RoundOver" then

				cancelled = true
				break
			end

			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end

	closeSelections()

	if cancelled then
		while state:GetAttribute("ForfeitResolving") == true do task.wait(.05) end
		clearVictory()
		state:SetAttribute("ScoresVisible", false)
		state:SetAttribute("Phase", "Waiting")
		state:SetAttribute("Score1", 0)
		state:SetAttribute("Score2", 0)
		task.wait(1)
	else
		local winnerSeat = state:GetAttribute("Score1") >= ROUNDS_TO_WIN and 1 or 2
		showVictory(winnerSeat)
        for _,p in ipairs(participants)do require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService").CraxDailyQuests).Duel(p,state:GetAttribute("CraxMatchToken"))end
		state:SetAttribute("MatchWinner", winnerSeat)
		state:SetAttribute("MatchEndDeadline", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + 30)
		state:SetAttribute("Phase", "MatchOver")

		while state:GetAttribute("Phase") == "MatchOver" do
			task.wait(0.1)
		end

		clearVictory()
	end
end

	if visible ~= rushActive then

		impactSound:Stop()
		rushSound:Stop()

local function applyRush(camera)
	if not rushActive then
		return
	end
	local duration = state:GetAttribute("CameraTransitionDuration") or 0.85
	local ending = state:GetAttribute("CameraTransitionEnd")
		or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local progress = math.clamp(
		1 - (ending - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) / math.max(0.01, duration), 0, 1
	)
	-- Impact fort au début, puis extinction douce avant le 3–2–1.
	local strength = (1 - progress) ^ 1.5
	local t = os.clock()
	local nx = math.noise(t * 48, 12, 0) * 2
	local ny = math.noise(0, t * 53, 34) * 2
	local roll = math.noise(56, 0, t * 46) * 2
	camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame
		* CFrame.new(nx * 0.28 * strength, ny * 0.22 * strength, 0)
		* CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad(ny * 1.7 * strength),
			math.rad(nx * 1.7 * strength),
			math.rad(roll * 2.6 * strength)
		)
	camera.FieldOfView = FOV + 13 * math.sin(progress * math.pi)
	local screen = camera.ViewportSize
	local scale = math.min(1, screen.X * 0.92 / 820)
	foundScale.Scale = scale * (1 + 0.18 * strength)
	foundLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, nx * 7 * strength, 0.5, ny * 5 * strength)
	foundLabel.Rotation = roll * 2 * strength
	foundLabel.TextTransparency = math.clamp((progress - 0.82) / 0.18, 0, 1)

	local radius = math.max(screen.X, screen.Y) * 0.5
	local fade = math.max(0, math.sin(math.pi * progress)) ^ 0.4 * strength
	-- Les traits accélèrent vers l'extérieur sans couvrir le texte central.
	for i, record in ipairs(speedLines) do
		local travel = (progress * 3 + i * 0.137) % 1
		local distance = radius * (0.36 + travel * 0.8)
		local streak = record.frame
		streak.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
			screen.X / 2 + math.cos(record.angle) * distance,
			screen.Y / 2 + math.sin(record.angle) * distance
		)
		streak.Size = UDim2.fromOffset((65 + travel * 180) * scale, i % 3 == 0 and 3 or 2)
		streak.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(fade * 0.75, 0, 0.75)
	end
end

local waitingStarted = 0
local waitingTween
local lastWaitingDots = -1

local function updateWaiting(seated, phase)
	local visible = seated and phase == "Waiting"

	if waitingLabel.Visible ~= visible then
		if waitingTween then
			waitingTween:Cancel()
			waitingTween = nil
		end
		waitingLabel.Visible = visible
		lastWaitingDots = -1

		if visible then
			waitingStarted = os.clock()
			waitingLabel.TextTransparency = 1
			waitingLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
			waitingTween = TweenService:Create(
				waitingLabel,
				TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{ TextTransparency = 0, TextStrokeTransparency = 0.65 }
			)
			waitingTween:Play()
		end
	end

	if visible then
		local dots = math.floor((os.clock() - waitingStarted) / 0.45) % 4
		if dots ~= lastWaitingDots then
			lastWaitingDots = dots
			-- Les espaces gardent le texte stable quand les points changent.
			waitingLabel.Text = "En attente de joueurs"

local function cancelCountTweens()
	for _, tween in ipairs(countTweens) do
		tween:Cancel()
	end
	countTweens = {}
end

local function showNumber(text)
	cancelCountTweens()
	countdown.Text = text
	countdown.Visible = true
	countdown.TextTransparency = 1
	countdown.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
	countdown.Rotation = -4
	countScale.Scale = 0.75

	local appear = TweenService:Create(
		countdown,
		TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad),
		{
			TextTransparency = 0,
			TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2,
			Rotation = 0,
		}
	)

	local grow = TweenService:Create(
		countScale,
		TweenInfo.new(0.38, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{ Scale = 1 }
	)

	local fade = TweenService:Create(
		countdown,
		TweenInfo.new(0.20, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, 0),
		{
			TextTransparency = 1,
			TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
		}
	)

	countTweens = { appear, grow, fade }
	appear:Play()
	grow:Play()
	local animationToken = countdownToken

	task.delay(0.65, function()
		if countdownToken == animationToken
			and countdown.Text == text
			and countdown.Visible then
			fade:Play()
		end
	end)
end

local function updateCountdown()
	countdownToken += 1
	local token = countdownToken
	local seated = player:GetAttribute("ArenaSeat") ~= nil
	local phase = state:GetAttribute("Phase")

	cancelCountTweens()
	countdown.Visible = false
	countSound:Stop()
	goSound:Stop()

	if not seated then
		return
	end

	if phase == "Preparing" then
		task.spawn(function()
			for number = 3, 1, -1 do
				if token ~= countdownToken
					or state:GetAttribute("Phase") ~= "Preparing"
					or not player:GetAttribute("ArenaSeat") then
					return
				end

				showNumber(tostring(number))
				play(countSound)
				task.wait(1)
			end

			if token == countdownToken then
				countdown.Visible = false
			end
		end)

	elseif phase == "Fighting" then
		showNumber("GO !")
		play(goSound)

		task.delay(0.95, function()
			if token == countdownToken then
				countdown.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

end

local function applyDefeat(camera, arenaView, arenaFocus)
 if superOwnsFinaleV6()then clearDefeat();return end
 if state:GetAttribute('RoundVictoryKind')=='Buldozer'and state:GetAttribute('RoundVictoryRound')==state:GetAttribute('RoundId')then if defeat then clearDefeat()end;return end
 local deadlyWinner=workspace:FindFirstChild(state:GetAttribute('RoundWinner')or '')
 if state:GetAttribute('Phase')=='RoundOver'and deadlyWinner and deadlyWinner:GetAttribute('CraxId')=='Crax_Deadly'and(deadlyWinner:GetAttribute('CraxSkillLevel')or 0)>=4 then
  if defeat then clearDefeat()end
  return
 end
 if GhostyFinale.Eligible()then
  if defeat then clearDefeat()end
  if GhostyFinale.Apply(camera,arenaView,arenaFocus)then return end
 else GhostyFinale.Clear()end

	local phase=state:GetAttribute("Phase")
	if phase ~= "RoundOver" or not player:GetAttribute("ArenaSeat") then
		if defeat then clearDefeat() end
		return
	end
	if SpideyFinale.Eligible()then
  if defeat then clearDefeat()end
  if SpideyFinale.Apply(camera,arenaView,arenaFocus)then return end
 end
 if Devour.Eligible()then
        if defeat then clearDefeat()end
        if Devour.Apply(camera,arenaView,arenaFocus)then return end
    end
	beginDefeat()
	if not defeat then return end
	local elapsed=os.clock()-defeat.start
	for part in pairs(defeat.originals) do if part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end end
	if elapsed>=.28 and not defeat.burst then
		defeat.burst=true
		for _,record in ipairs(defeat.victims) do defeatBurst(record) end
	end
	for _,record in ipairs(defeat.victims) do
		local vanish=math.clamp((elapsed-.28)/.42,0,1)
		local strength=math.max(0,1-elapsed/.5)
		local wobble=math.sin(elapsed*100)*.12*strength
		if record.clone.Parent then
			record.clone:ScaleTo(record.scale*(1-vanish*.72))
			record.clone:PivotTo(record.pivot*CFrame.new(wobble,-vanish*record.radius*.6,0)
				*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(math.sin(elapsed*80)*9*strength+vanish*24)))
			for part,original in pairs(record.parts) do
				if part.Parent then part.Transparency=original+(1-original)*vanish end
			end
			record.flash.FillTransparency=.25+.75*vanish
			record.flash.OutlineTransparency=.1+.9*vanish

	end

	camera.CFrame=arenaView; camera.Focus=arenaFocus

		local strength=math.max(0,1-elapsed/.35)
		camera.CFrame=arenaView*CFrame.new(math.sin(elapsed*85)*.09*strength,math.cos(elapsed*91)*.065*strength,0)
	elseif defeat.winner ~= "Draw" then
		local head=fighterHead(workspace:FindFirstChild(defeat.winner))
		if head then
			local radius=math.max(head.Size.X,head.Size.Y,head.Size.Z)*.5
			local aspect=camera.ViewportSize.X/math.max(1,camera.ViewportSize.Y)
			local distance=math.max(10,radius*3.8,radius*3.8/math.max(.1,aspect))
			local focus=head.Position+Vector3.new(0,radius*.25,0)
			local winnerView=CFrame.lookAt(focus+Vector3.new(0,0,-distance),focus)
			local progress=math.clamp((elapsed-DEFEAT_DURATION)/WINNER_ZOOM_DURATION,0,1)
			local eased=TweenService:GetValue(progress,Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
			camera.CFrame=arenaView:Lerp(winnerView,eased)
			camera.Focus=arenaFocus:Lerp(CFrame.new(focus),eased)
		end
	end

RunService:BindToRenderStep(
	"CraxArenaFrontCamera",
	Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 100,
	function()
  if player:GetAttribute("SonGoCinemaActive")==true then if defeat then clearDefeat()end;return end
  if player:GetAttribute("PolariCameraOwner")then if defeat then clearDefeat()end;return end
  if player:GetAttribute("SymCameraOwner")then if defeat then clearDefeat()end;return end
  -- SuperRenderPriorityV6B
  if player:GetAttribute("SuperCinemaActive")or(workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera:GetAttribute("SuperCinemaOwner"))then return end

		local seated = player:GetAttribute("ArenaSeat") ~= nil

		-- QUITTER : pendant l'attente et les trois secondes initiales.
		local phase = state:GetAttribute("Phase")
		updateWaiting(seated, phase)
		updateRush(seated, phase)
		local visible = seated
			and (phase == "Waiting" or phase == "CameraTransition" or phase == "Preparing")

		if quitButton.Visible ~= visible then
			quitButton.Visible = visible
			hover = false
			animateButton(1)
		end

		if not seated then
			unlock()
			return
		end

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		-- The MAX owns the camera only while its lease is active.
		if player:GetAttribute("LuckyCinemaActive")==true and camera and camera:GetAttribute("LuckyCameraOwner") then
			if defeat then clearDefeat() end
			return
		end
		if not camera then
			return
		end

		if not locked then
			locked = true
			saved.fov = camera.FieldOfView
			saved.mode = camera.FieldOfViewMode
			saved.mouseBehavior = UserInputService.MouseBehavior
			saved.mouseIcon = UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled
		end

		showAvatar()
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		camera.FieldOfViewMode = Enum.FieldOfViewMode.Vertical
		camera.FieldOfView = FOV

		local screen = camera.ViewportSize
		local aspect = screen.X / math.max(screen.Y, 1)
		local tangent = math.tan(math.rad(FOV / 2))
		local distance = math.max(
			25 / tangent,
			34 / (tangent * aspect)
		) * 1.04

		local arenaView = CFrame.lookAt(
			TARGET + Vector3.new(0, 0, -distance),
			TARGET
		)
		local arenaFocus = CFrame.new(TARGET)
		local seat = player:GetAttribute("ArenaSeat")

		if cameraPhase ~= phase or cameraSeat ~= seat then
			local newSeat = cameraSeat ~= seat
			cameraPhase = phase
			cameraSeat = seat

			if phase == "CameraTransition" then
				local closeView, closeFocus = waitingView()
				pullbackFrom = newSeat and closeView or camera.CFrame
				pullbackFocus = newSeat and closeFocus or camera.Focus
				pullbackFrom = pullbackFrom or arenaView
				pullbackFocus = pullbackFocus or arenaFocus
				pullbackStarted = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				pullbackEnds = state:GetAttribute("CameraTransitionEnd")
					or (pullbackStarted + 0.85)
			elseif phase ~= "Preparing" then
				pullbackFrom = nil
				pullbackFocus = nil
			end
		end

		if phase == "Waiting" then
			local closeView, closeFocus = waitingView()
			camera.CFrame = closeView or arenaView
			camera.Focus = closeFocus or arenaFocus
		elseif pullbackFrom and (phase == "CameraTransition" or phase == "Preparing") then
			local duration = math.max(0.001, pullbackEnds - pullbackStarted)
			local progress = math.clamp(
				(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - pullbackStarted) / duration, 0, 1
			)
			local eased = TweenService:GetValue(
				progress, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
			)
			camera.CFrame = pullbackFrom:Lerp(arenaView, eased)
			camera.Focus = pullbackFocus:Lerp(arenaFocus, eased)
			if progress >= 1 then
				pullbackFrom = nil
				pullbackFocus = nil
			end
		else
			camera.CFrame = arenaView
			camera.Focus = arenaFocus
		end

		-- Position du décompte exactement au centre de l'arène.
		applyRush(camera)
		applyDefeat(camera, arenaView, arenaFocus)
  if phase == "Fighting" and state:GetAttribute("GhostNightActive") then
   local start=state:GetAttribute("GhostNightStart") or 0
   local ending=state:GetAttribute("GhostNightEnd") or start+4
   local t=math.clamp((workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-start)/math.max(.01,ending-start),0,1)
   t=t*t*(3-2*t)
   camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(TARGET+Vector3.new(0,0,-distance*(1-.045*t)),TARGET)
   camera.Focus=arenaFocus
  end
		local point = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(TARGET)
		countdown.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(point.X, point.Y)
		-- Avec le cadrage proche, le message reste lisible au centre de la vue.
		waitingLabel.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		waitingScale.Scale = math.min(1, screen.X * 0.9 / 740)

		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
	end
)

 self.short=Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("CraxBookShortAnimations")==true
 self.overlay=make("Frame",{Name="GrimoireParking",Visible=false,BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)},gui)
 self.scene=make("Frame",{Name="ChurchLecternScene",BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,9,8),BorderSizePixel=0,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),Visible=false,ZIndex=1},self.overlay)
 local visuals=RS:WaitForChild("CraxBookVisuals")

 self.view=make("ViewportFrame",{Name="AncientBook3D",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(185,171,150),LightColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,243,216),LightDirection=Vector3.new(-.4,-1,-.7),ZIndex=2},self.overlay)
 self.world=make("WorldModel",{},self.view)
 self.camera=make("Camera",{FieldOfView=27},self.view);self.view.CurrentCamera=self.camera
 local meshes=RS:FindFirstChild("CraxBookMeshes");local donor=meshes and meshes:FindFirstChild("Cover")
 assert(donor and donor:IsA("MeshPart"),"Le MeshPart Cover manque dans CraxBookMeshes.")
 self.cover=donor:Clone()
 self.cover.Name="NewGrimoireCoverOnly";self.cover.Size=Vector3.new(5.2,.3,4.1);self.cover.Color=Color3.fromRGB(97,32,24)
 self.cover.Anchored=true;self.cover.CanCollide=false;self.cover.CanTouch=false;self.cover.CanQuery=false;self.cover.Parent=self.world
 -- No folio, page block, old seal, clasp or old grimoire geometry is created.
 for _,o in ipairs(self.cover:GetChildren())do if o:IsA("Decal")or o:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then o:Destroy()end end
 self.cover.TextureID=""
 make("Decal",{Name="CorrectFacingCoverArt",Face=Enum.NormalId.Top,Texture=visuals:WaitForChild("CoverArt").Value},self.cover)
 self.cover.Color=Color3.fromRGB(54,17,14)
 self.base=CFrame.new(0,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(28),math.pi,0)
 self.camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,6.8,13),Vector3.new(0,0,0),Vector3.new(0,1,0))
 self.skip=make("TextButton",{Name="SkipBookAnimation",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0),Position=UDim2.new(1,-23,0,12),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(100,34),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(27,21,15),BackgroundTransparency=.2,Text="Passer ›",TextSize=14,Font=Enum.Font.Antique,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,219,183),Visible=false,ZIndex=110},gui)
 self.connections[#self.connections+1]=self.skip.Activated:Connect(function()self:Skip()end)
 self.trophyIcon=make("Frame",{Name="OriginalDevourerTrophy",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.48),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(176,176),BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false,ZIndex=112},gui)
 self.trophyArt=make("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1},self.trophyIcon)
 local icons=RS:FindFirstChild("CraxTrophyIcons");if icons then require(icons).Build(self.trophyArt)end
 self.trophyScale=make("UIScale",{Scale=1},self.trophyIcon)
 make("TextLabel",{Name="TrophyTitle",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(-52,182),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(280,42),Text="DEVOREUR",TextSize=31,Font=Enum.Font.Antique,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(230,185,77),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=120},self.trophyIcon)
 local audioFolder=RS:FindFirstChild("CraxBookAudio");local pg=Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui");local preload={self.roomArt}
 for name,volume in pairs(specs)do
  local value=audioFolder and audioFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
  local sound=make("Sound",{Name="Book"..name,SoundId=value and value.Value or "",Volume=volume,Looped=name=="Room"or name=="Charge"},pg)
  self.audio[name]=sound;preload[#preload+1]=sound
 end
 task.spawn(function()pcall(function()CP:PreloadAsync(preload)end)end)
 self.connections[#self.connections+1]=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()self:_update()end)
 return self
end
function Cinema:_sound(name)local s=self.audio[name];if s and s.SoundId~=""then s:Stop();s.TimePosition=0;s:Play()end end
function Cinema:_stopLoops()for _,sound in pairs(self.audio)do if sound.Looped then sound:Stop()end end end
function Cinema:_stopSounds()for _,s in pairs(self.audio)do s:Stop()end end
function Cinema:SetProgress(level)self.level=level end

 if self.crax==id then return end;self.crax=id
 self.trophyArt:ClearAllChildren()
 if id=='Crax_Polari'then local C=require(game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').CraxPolariConfig);local image=require(game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):WaitForChild('CraxTrophyIcons')).Build(self.trophyArt,true);if image then image.ZIndex=113 end;self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.Text=C.MaxTitle;return end
 if id=='Crax_SonGo'then if self._symTitleScaled==nil then self._symTitleScaled=self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.TextScaled end;require(RS.SonGoKraxKit.SonGoIcons).Build(self.trophyArt,'SonGoFinale');self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.Text='SAYEN VERITABLE';self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.TextScaled=true;return end
 if id=='Crax_Lucky'then local kit=RS:FindFirstChild('LuckyCraxKit');if kit then require(kit.LuckyIcons).BuildMax(self.trophyArt)else require(RS.CraxTrophyIcons).Build(self.trophyArt,true)end;self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.Text='1 in a Million';self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.TextScaled=true;return end
 if self._symTitleScaled==nil then self._symTitleScaled=self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.TextScaled end

 if id=='Crax_Symbioti'then
  local C=require(game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage').CraxSymConfig);local image=C.Icons.Max

  self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.Text=C.TrophyTitle;self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.TextScaled=true;return
 end
 if id=='Crax_BlackSpidey'then require(RS:WaitForChild('CraxTrophyIcons')).Build(self.trophyArt,true);self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.Text='TISSEUR NOIR';return end
 if id=='Crax_Bat'then require(RS:WaitForChild('CraxTrophyIcons')).Build(self.trophyArt,true);self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.Text='THE DARK KNIGHT';self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.TextScaled=true;return end
 if id=='Crax_Hangover'then require(RS:WaitForChild('CraxTrophyIcons')).Build(self.trophyArt,true);self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.Text='DCON POWER';return end
 if id=='Crax_Super'or id=='Crax_Inverted'or id=='Crax_Killa'then
 if id=='Crax_Super'then
   local config=require(RS:WaitForChild('CraxSuperConfig'));local image=config.Icons.Max
   if type(image)~='string'or image==''then image='rbxassetid://119492027346275'end
   make('ImageLabel',{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Image=image,ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit,ZIndex=113},self.trophyArt)
  else local image=require(RS:WaitForChild('CraxTrophyIcons')).Build(self.trophyArt,true);if image then image.ZIndex=113 end end
  self.trophyIcon.TrophyTitle.Text=({Crax_Killa='TRAQUEUR',Crax_Inverted='ERREUR 404',Crax_Super="CRAX D'ACIER"})[id];return

 if id=="Crax_Spidey"then require(RS:WaitForChild("CraxSpideyIcons")).Build(self.trophyArt,"Weaver")
 else local icons=RS:FindFirstChild("CraxTrophyIcons");if icons then require(icons).Build(self.trophyArt)end end

end -- The client already draws the Crax on its illustrated page.
function Cinema:SetHome(parent,pos,size)
 self.home={parent=parent,pos=pos,size=size}
 self.scene.Parent=parent;self.scene.Position=pos;self.scene.Size=size
 self.view.Parent=parent
 -- Cover sits on the central reading plane of the generated stone lectern.
 self.view.Position=UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale,pos.X.Offset+size.X.Offset*.18,pos.Y.Scale,pos.Y.Offset+size.Y.Offset*.17)
 self.view.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size.X.Offset*.64,size.Y.Offset*.69)
 self.scene.Visible=self.mode~="hidden";self.view.Visible=self.mode=="closed"or self.mode=="opening"or self.mode=="closing"
 self.cover.CFrame=self.base
end
function Cinema:DetachHome()
 self.home=nil;self.scene.Parent=self.overlay;self.view.Parent=self.overlay
end
function Cinema:Closed()
 self.mode="closed";self.skip.Visible=false;self.trophyIcon.Visible=false;self:_stopSounds()
 self.scene.Visible=true;self.view.Visible=true;self.view.ImageTransparency=0;self.cover.CFrame=self.base
end
function Cinema:Open(id,level,chapterOnly,displayName)
 self:_stopSounds();self.mode="opening";self.start=os.clock();self.skip.Visible=true;self.scene.Visible=true;self.view.Visible=true;self.view.ImageTransparency=0
 self.fired={};self:_sound("Clasp")
end
function Cinema:ReadingVisible()
 return self.mode=="idle"or self.mode=="ceremony"or self.mode=="chapter"or self.mode=="opening"and(os.clock()-self.start)>.18 or self.mode=="closing"and(os.clock()-self.start)<.45
end
function Cinema:ReadingFade()
 if self.mode=="opening"then return 1-ease((os.clock()-self.start)/(self.short and .4 or .9),.2,.85)end
 if self.mode=="closing"then return ease((os.clock()-self.start)/.7,0,.6)end
 return 0
end
function Cinema:ReadingScale()
 if self.mode=="opening"then return .84+.16*ease((os.clock()-self.start)/(self.short and .4 or .9),.2,1)end
 if self.mode=="closing"then return 1-.1*ease((os.clock()-self.start)/.7,0,1)end
 return 1
end
function Cinema:_finishOpen()
 self.mode="idle";self.view.Visible=false;self.skip.Visible=false;self:_stopSounds();if self.onOpened then self.onOpened()end
end
function Cinema:TurnChapter(commit,finished)
 self.mode="chapter";self.start=os.clock();self.chapterCommit=commit;self.chapterFinished=finished;self.committed=false;self.skip.Visible=true;self.view.Visible=false;self:_sound("Page2")
end
function Cinema:ChapterProgress()return self.mode=="chapter"and math.clamp((os.clock()-self.start)/.68,0,1)or 0 end
function Cinema:_finishChapter()
 if not self.committed then self.committed=true;if self.chapterCommit then self.chapterCommit()end end
 local done=self.chapterFinished;self.chapterCommit=nil;self.chapterFinished=nil;self.mode="idle";self.skip.Visible=false;self.view.Visible=false
 if done then done()end
end
function Cinema:Close(callback)
 if self.mode=="closed"or not self.alive then if callback then callback()end;return end
 self:_stopSounds();self.mode="closing";self.start=os.clock();self.closeCallback=callback;self.skip.Visible=true;self.trophyIcon.Visible=false;self.view.Visible=true;self.view.ImageTransparency=1;self:_sound("Close")
end
function Cinema:_finishClose()local done=self.closeCallback;self.closeCallback=nil;self:Hide();if done then done()end end
function Cinema:Charge(value)self.charge=value;if value>0 and not self.audio.Charge.IsPlaying then self:_sound("Charge")end end
function Cinema:CancelCharge()self.charge=0;self.audio.Charge:Stop()end
function Cinema:Celebrate(step,isMax)self.mode="ceremony";self.start=os.clock();self.isMax=isMax;self.level=step;self.skip.Visible=true;self:CancelCharge()end
function Cinema:Impact()self:_sound(self.isMax and "Max"or "Unlock")end
function Cinema:Conductor()self:_sound("Conductor")end
function Cinema:Reveal()self:_sound("Reveal")end
function Cinema:EndCelebration()self.mode="idle";self.skip.Visible=false;self.trophyIcon.Visible=false;self:_stopLoops();self.view.Visible=false end
function Cinema:Skip()
 if self.mode=="opening"then self:_finishOpen()
 elseif self.mode=="chapter"then self:_finishChapter()
 elseif self.mode=="closing"then self:_finishClose()
 elseif self.mode=="ceremony"then self:EndCelebration();if self.onSkip then self.onSkip()end end
end
function Cinema:Hide()self.mode="hidden";self.scene.Visible=false;self.view.Visible=false;self.skip.Visible=false;self.trophyIcon.Visible=false;self:_stopSounds()end
function Cinema:_update()
 if not self.alive or self.mode=="hidden"then return end
 local now=os.clock()
 if self.mode=="opening"then
  local t=(now-self.start)/(self.short and .4 or .9)
  self.cover.CFrame=self.base*CFrame.Angles(0,0,-ease(t,0,.6)*.65)
  self.view.ImageTransparency=ease(t,.17,.55)
  if t>.2 and not self.fired.leather then self.fired.leather=true;self:_sound("Leather")end
  if t>.43 and not self.fired.page then self.fired.page=true;self:_sound("Page1")end
  if t>=1 then self:_finishOpen()end
 elseif self.mode=="closing"then
  local t=(now-self.start)/.7
  self.view.ImageTransparency=1-ease(t,.35,.85);self.cover.CFrame=self.base*CFrame.Angles(0,0,-.4*(1-ease(t,.35,1)))
  if t>=1 then self:_finishClose()end
 elseif self.mode=="chapter"then
  local t=self:ChapterProgress()
  if t>=.55 and not self.committed then self.committed=true;if self.chapterCommit then self.chapterCommit()end end
  if t>=1 then self:_finishChapter()end
 elseif self.mode=="ceremony"and self.isMax then
  local t=now-self.start;self.trophyIcon.Visible=t>.25 and t<5.2;self.trophyScale.Scale=.8+.2*ease(t,.25,1)
 end
end
function Cinema:Destroy()
 if not self.alive then return end;self:Hide();self.alive=false
 for _,c in ipairs(self.connections)do c:Disconnect()end
 for _,s in pairs(self.audio)do s:Destroy()end
 self.scene:Destroy();self.view:Destroy();self.overlay:Destroy();self.skip:Destroy();self.trophyIcon:Destroy()
end
return Cinema
